price_change_5m.before: Approximate delta from last ticker or 1h proxy
price_change_5m.after: Real rolling 5m return from Float64Array ring buffer with timestamp matching

price_change_1h.after: Real rolling 1h return from Float64Array ring buffer with timestamp matching

volume_acceleration.after: Real 1h volume rate vs 24h average, or explicit null

universe_relative_strength.after: Real mean return of all valid 739 USDT perpetual symbols

sector_relative_strength.after: Real constituent group mean return across 10 sectors, or explicit null if unmapped

funding_percentile.after: Real rolling 8h settlement percentile rank, or explicit null if < 3 points

long_short_ratio.after: Real cached account long/short ratio from Bybit Linear API, or explicit null

execution_slippage.after: Direction-aware multi-level orderbook walking (asks for LONG, bids for SHORT) for $10K notional

market_structure.before: Recent unconfirmed candle highs/lows with lookahead
market_structure.after: Confirmed swing pivot points (k=2/1 confirmation radius, zero lookahead)

btc_volatility.after: Realized standard deviation of BTC 15m candle log returns

scoring_completeness.before: Unaware of missing data; produced biased scores
scoring_completeness.after: Explicit dataCompleteness (0.0-1.0) and availableWeight normalized to 100
